<div id="regression-demo" class="regression-demo">

<div class="regression-panel">

<div class="regression-controls">

<label class="regression-control">
<span>Intercept</span>
<input data-param="intercept" type="range" min="0" max="10" step="0.1" value="3">
<span data-value="intercept"></span>
</label>

<label class="regression-control">
<span>Slope</span>
<input data-param="slope" type="range" min="-0.5" max="1.5" step="0.05" value="0.75">
<span data-value="slope"></span>
</label>

</div>

<p class="regression-total">Total squared error:<br><strong class="regression-error-total" aria-live="polite"></strong></p>

</div>

<svg></svg>

</div>
